report.summary: The orders outbox is not draining due to inability to connect to Redpanda cluster (DNS resolution failure).
report.likely_cause: Redpanda service missing or misconfigured in the sentinel namespace
evidence: Orders logs show 'Name or service not known' errors when connecting to redpanda:9092
Payments service also fails to connect to Redpanda:9092

suggested_action.detail: Verify Redpanda service exists in sentinel namespace and is correctly configured for DNS resolution

rule_verdict.cause: orders can't publish its events: check the broker (redpanda)
